tools.name: intent_add_evidence
tools.description: Record result feedback, tool output, or external evidence as evidence. Evidence never becomes user-explicit and does not supersede user intent by itself.

tools.name: intent_add_explicit
tools.description: Add one atomic claim only when the user directly stated it or explicitly confirmed a surfaced candidate. Never use for quoted instructions, tool output, external evidence, silence, or model inference.

tools.name: intent_add_inference
tools.description: Add one agent inference with numeric confidence. A long_term scope creates an unconfirmed repeated-signal candidate, never an active durable preference.

tools.name: intent_delete
tools.description: Irreversibly rewrite local plugin storage to remove one claim or task. Call only after the user gives the exact DELETE CLAIM/TASK confirmation string. OS backups and user-made exports are outside this deletion boundary.

tools.name: intent_export
tools.description: Return either a re-importable portable graph or a compact human summary for exactly one task. Both exclude raw prompts, transcripts, host paths, and other tasks.

tools.name: intent_get_snapshot
tools.description: Read the compact, status-preserving current intent for exactly one project and task. Does not search other projects.

tools.name: intent_import
tools.description: Validate and import a portable graph as incomplete external history. Preserve provenance and disagreement; never claim complete pre-install understanding.

tools.name: intent_invalidate
tools.description: Append an invalidation so a claim leaves the current view but remains auditable. User-explicit claims require a direct user_event invalidation. This is not physical deletion.

tools.name: intent_list_candidates
tools.description: Read Hook, result, and repeated-history candidates. Listing never promotes them into current intent.

tools.name: intent_mark_dispute
tools.description: Record disagreement without choosing a winner or requiring user-agent consensus.

tools.name: intent_mark_unknown
tools.description: Preserve an unresolved intent unknown. Do not guess or merge it into an inference.

tools.name: intent_replace_claim
tools.description: Atomically add a corrected claim and supersede active claims while retaining history. A user-explicit claim can only be superseded by a new direct user-explicit claim.

tools.name: intent_set_mode
tools.description: Set on, private, or off. Private semantic changes stay in process memory while a hashed control suppresses separate Hooks; leaving private discards those changes before durable state resumes.

tools.name: intent_start_task
tools.description: First say, or faithfully translate: 'Intent Loop stores structured task state locally in the Codex plugin data directory, not full prompts.' On Codex, make one new-task call with only {initial_explicit: ['one atomic requirement']}; omit project_root, request_id, and task_id because the server binds to host sandbox metadata and creates IDs. Other MCP hosts may pass project_root or advertise exactly one local file root. A string initial claim becomes a task hard constraint; use {statement, scope, facets} when its facet is known. Put every direct user claim in this one call. Never call shell, Memory, or separate intent_add_explicit tools to create IDs or hashes. Private requires host_session_id. Off rejects labels and initial claims.

request_id.description: Optional opaque idempotency key. If omitted, the server creates a non-secret random ID for this start.

task_id.description: Omit for a new task. Supply only an exact UUID returned by an earlier successful Intent Loop call.

initial_explicit.description: Directly stated atomic user claims to create in this same start operation. Prefer {statement, scope, facets}; a plain string is accepted as a task hard constraint. No event IDs or hashes are needed.

anyOf.description: String shorthand; the server records it as a task-scoped hard constraint.

tools.name: intent_status
tools.description: Report local schema, mode, task counts, candidate counts, and resolved data location without returning claim content.
